newsitem.title: USA: US March S&P 500s rally to a sharply higher close.
newsitem.headline: US March S&P 500s rally to a sharply higher close.

text.p: Dec 19 - U.S. March S&P 500s rallied to a sharply higher close, as December S&Ps expired. March rose 15.65 points to 753.80, above last Thursday's high of 752.50. The next resistance level is at 755.00. Traders look for further gains into expiration of stock options, and other index contracts, on Friday.
